Privacy information

Updated 2026-10-18

Who operates this website

ORBITAL is an independent digital development studio. Contact rounakpro18@gmail.com with questions about this website or an enquiry you have submitted.

Project enquiries

The enquiry form collects your name, email address, selected service, and project message. It sends this information through FormSubmit to the studio’s Gmail inbox so we can respond and discuss your request. Do not include passwords, payment details, or sensitive personal records.

WhatsApp and external links

The WhatsApp button opens WhatsApp with a prepared message. Clicking it does not automatically send that message. WhatsApp, app stores, and external project websites apply their own privacy policies when you visit them.

Hosting, fonts, and analytics

Vercel hosts this public website and may process technical request data to deliver and protect the service. Google Fonts supplies the website fonts, so your browser contacts Google when loading them. This website currently includes no Google Analytics or advertising-pixel scripts.

Enquiry correspondence and your choices

Your message is used to respond to your enquiry and any resulting project conversation. To request access, correction, or deletion of enquiry correspondence, email rounakpro18@gmail.com. We will review the request and any requirements to retain business correspondence.

Third-party services

The contact form, email inbox, hosting, fonts, and messaging links involve third-party providers. Their policies govern their own processing. You can choose to contact the studio directly by email instead of using the form.

Provider policies: FormSubmit, Vercel, Google, WhatsApp.
